scripts.build: node -e "fs.rmSync('node_modules/.vite-temp', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:prod: node -e "fs.rmSync('node_modules/.vite-temp', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node -e "process.env.BUILD_MODE='prod'; require('child_process').execSync('vite build', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true })"
scripts.android:sync: pnpm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: pnpm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat installDebug && adb shell am start -n com.dwgviewer.pro/.MainActivity
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules .pnpm-store pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm store prune
